purpose: Measure the predictive value of the exact seven global metadata inputs supplied to the unified Ma--Li-style Graph V3-large adaptation, with the graph branch removed. This is an internal comparator, not a paper reproduction.

input_features.normalization: per-outer-fold mean/std fit on outer-train only; std < 1e-6 replaced by 1.0
input_features.feature_source: S67/C134 V3 common feature sidecar; the runner reads only the seven named columns. circuit_count must equal 1 but is asserted, not passed to the model.

population_and_comparison.metadata_baseline_policy: All seven sidecar features are present and finite for all 8,767 rows, including row4477. The baseline attempt envelope retains 8,767 assigned IDs. To match Graph V3-large training support exactly, exclude row4477 from every outer-train fit. Predict it once as a fold-0 held-out supplementary metadata-only case, but exclude that row from primary paired error. Primary paired graph-vs-baseline accuracy uses the exact 8,766 shared IDs.
population_and_comparison.training_population_note: For each outer fold, train IDs are exactly V3-large eligible IDs (all canonical IDs except row4477, then excluding that fold's test IDs). Fold-0 row4477 remains a supplementary test prediction only. This matches graph training support and avoids a training-population advantage.

target_and_split.assignment: Use the frozen unified outer fold and grouped inner-fold assignments without editing or reseeding. Each outer fold is trained on outer_fold != k and predicts exactly outer_fold == k. Assert group disjointness.
target_and_split.inner_split_use: QA only. Architecture, optimizer, epochs, and seeds are fixed from the graph contract; no tuning, early stopping, or seed selection is performed.

model.architecture: Seven normalized global features -> Linear(7,64)+ReLU -> Linear(64,64)+ReLU. Concatenate a fixed zero-valued 64-wide graph slot to retain the V3-large 128-wide downstream head input; then Linear(128,512)+ReLU -> Linear(512,512)+ReLU -> Linear(512,128)+ReLU -> Linear(128,1). No graph nodes, edges, vocabulary or qubit-position features are read.
model.loss: row-weighted mean squared error on log1p(target_seconds), matching S71 graph training loss
model.seed_authority: Fixed graph protocol seed list; each value must appear in benchmark_v1/registry/seed_registry.json historical_seeds_preserved.
model.seed_reduction: rowwise median of the three per-seed held-out predictions

compute.training_device: CUDA required; fail closed if unavailable; no CPU fallback
compute.preflight_device: CPU metadata/identity validation only; does not train

commands.complete_technical_gated_fit_shell: set -euo pipefail; FEATURES=artifacts/benchmark_v3/recovery_real_qpu_20260929_v3/c134_feature_sidecar_v3.csv; OUT=artifacts/benchmark_v3/real_qpu/global_metadata_mlp_v1; export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2; python benchmark_v1/scripts/run_qpu_global_metadata_mlp_baseline_v1.py --stage preflight --features $FEATURES; for FOLD in 0 1 2 3 4; do python benchmark_v1/scripts/run_qpu_global_metadata_mlp_baseline_v1.py --stage fit --fold $FOLD --features $FEATURES --output-dir $OUT/fold_$FOLD; python benchmark_v1/scripts/run_qpu_global_metadata_mlp_baseline_v1.py --stage validate_fold --fold $FOLD --features $FEATURES --output-dir $OUT/fold_$FOLD; done

checkpointing.interruption_policy: run manifest remains status=running with last checkpoint; do not reuse the directory or imply automatic resume; preserve as failed/incomplete and start a new attempt directory if rerunning

technical_fit_gates: C134 sidecar restored/pinned; canonical, split, seed, graph OOF and feature hashes pass before fitting
CUDA required; S85 shared timing + host-GPU lock acquired before availability/inventory/smoke/training/inference CUDA calls
fresh CUDA forward/backward smoke finite; GPU model, driver, total memory, CUDA and PyTorch versions recorded
fit creates status=running manifest before acquiring compute lock; existing output path is rejected before imports/training
each fold emits assigned-ID-complete attempts/predictions; all values finite; source/group IDs match frozen split; primary/supplementary labels exact
each fold emits all three seeds at epochs 50,100,...,500 with model/optimizer/RNG checkpoint state and hashes
validate_fold command must PASS for a fold before shell loop advances; row4477 is supplementary in fold 0 only and primary paired comparison remains exactly 8,766 rows
